newsitem.title: UK: Wolstenholme Rink cautious on H2 trading.
newsitem.headline: Wolstenholme Rink cautious on H2 trading.

text.p: Wolstenholme Rink Plc said on Friday that it is now clear trading in the second half will not do as well as it had expected at the time of its interim statement on September 18.
However, the printing materials manufacturer said that second half profits are still expected to be at least the same as those for the first half.

In Wolstenholme's half year statement in September, the group said trading so far in the second half confirmed their view that second half profits would be above those of the comparable period of 1995.

It said today that although July and August showed an improved situation, this has not continued in September and October. In addition, its Resin Division, which is being sold to Lawter International Inc. for 5.5 million stg in cash, performed well below expectations.
